 CLIENT[\"Your computer: EC2 public IPv4:8080\"] --> AWS[\"AWS translation and Security Group\"]
 AWS --> PRE[\"PREROUTING: destination is host-local\"]
 LOCAL[\"EC2 host: 127.0.0.1:8080\"] --> OUT[\"OUTPUT: destination is host-local\"]
 PRE --> DNAT[\"DNAT to 172.18.0.2:80\"]
 OUT --> DNAT
 DNAT --> PATH{\"Packet originated outside this host?\"}
 PATH -->|\"Yes\"| FORWARD[\"FORWARD allows this published connection\"]
 PATH -->|\"No\"| LOCALSNAT[\"Loopback-source traffic gets bridge MASQUERADE\"]
 FORWARD --> APP[\"Nginx in container A\"]
 LOCALSNAT --> APP

 classDef decision fill:#fff2cc,stroke:#d6b656
 classDef success fill:#d5e8d4,stroke:#82b366
 class CLIENT,AWS,PRE,LOCAL,OUT,DNAT,FORWARD,LOCALSNAT route
 class PATH decision
 class APP success",
 "config": null,
